proposal.summary: Add conditional native GPT-Live integration, documented Private Link availability with deployment prerequisites unknown, and the SDK safety_identifier constraint. Its numeric Responses-equivalent limit is unknown from the fetched SDK passage. Record captured provenance only on the three new feature facts. Retain exact native gpt-6-luna and Copilot gpt-6-luna-decisions support, /decisions relative to /v1 versus full /v1/decisions, 1-400 typed questions, conversation/JSON/image restrictions and existing cache constraints. The pinned Copilot test is not fresh live evidence; PAT rejection remains an authentication restriction, the Actions success remains limited to copilot-requests: write and agentic-workflows, and other credential acceptance remains unknown. No endpoint translation, credential probing, networking changes, Copilot feature inheritance or harness requirements are introduced. Scheduled upkeep remains incomplete: copilot-pricing has ambiguous exact-ID mappings, copilot-changelog is a listing without fetched announcement details, and new native OpenAI mappings for gpt-6.2-astra, gpt-6.2-sol and gpt-6.1-terra failed the legacy Copilot family parity test. Those mapping proposals were withdrawn, retaining the prior mapping bytes without changing tests or inventing Copilot associations. All unrelated canonical and staged facts remain unchanged.
